verdict_rationale: 8/8 SAT pass and all 5 axes >= 7.0, but overall 8.65 < the 9.0 DEPLOY floor and sigma 0.833 exceeds the dynamic floor of 0.75 for a >2000-word prompt (self-eval.py dynamic_sigma_floor). Per the honest-numbers contract this is HOLD, not DEPLOY, regardless of the strong axis scores. Convergence plateaued after 4 iterations (see learnings.md); a further heuristic-score push would require rewriting the Invariants list into materially shorter sentences, which risks losing the precision the invariants are graded on — judged not worth the tradeoff within the time budget. The hardening-only pass 2 requested by the lead deliberately did not chase score (scores moved by +0.01, noise from the 4 patches' text) — every edit in pass 2 was attack-driven, not score-driven, per explicit instruction.
